basis: C44-A15/A15a strictly reduces the original universal fixed-axis gate: after any known positive cycle span, at most one residual potential Tate direction is now settled without Tate, D, semisimplicity or cycle lifting. For sixfold axes the remaining unconditioned cyclotomic multiplicity is at least3. C44-W01–W05 and W12–W13 also close the original characteristic-p TheoremW task with explicit corrected signature/lattice hypotheses and the stated unrefereed032/Milne2026 conditions. These are mathematical changes, not packaging.
additional_scope: C06/C06a closes geometric lifting for every cover map and smooth incidence, but not cycle lifting. F15–F22 remove specified P18 families; the whole Fermat AJ5 finite-generation gate F07 is unchanged. The exact F07 criterion, arithmetic local countermodels, new positive subspaces, source audits and the Th5 compilation are not counted by themselves as movement. A18 constrained-centre moment work, if unfinished, remains pending and is not used in this review.

rows.question: Fixed-axis sign for every smooth axis over Fbar_p, m>2
rows.finding_ids_or_current_gate: C44-A15/A15a proves the entire axis form positive whenever normalized variable Frobenius has total root-of-unity multiplicity<=1, or a known positive span leaves at most one such direction. General gate now excludes those cases: without a known span it requires multiplicity>=2, and >=3 for every sixfold axis. A13/A13b separately compute positive entire kernels on dense closed supersingular families. No universal sign or wrong-sign class. A17 gives even negative index if the residual Tate block is fully algebraic; A17a/b show why away-p local comparison and full weak admissibility do not fix the remaining sign. Gate unchanged by these method obstructions.

rows.question: Every primitive axis class lifts with its axis to characteristic zero
rows.finding_ids_or_current_gate: A05 lifts every embedded axis. A10 gives a nonliftable ambient class with zero variable projection. A14 gives a smooth abstractly nonliftable surface and an uncorrected nonliftable axis class with nonzero primitive component, but the obstruction cancels on that component. A13/A13b full selected kernels lift. Universal class lifting in A_B remains open. A14a proves that the same zero-stabilizer obstruction cannot survive on variable classes through the ordinary cup ring.

Remaining first-dimension Frobenius gate: total cyclotomic multiplicity>=3, or at least2 residual directions after any known positive span.

rows.question: Special covers and their new algebraic middle classes
rows.finding_ids_or_current_gate: C44-C01 separates the positive old kernel. C02/C04 cover all generic triple splitting strata. C05 covers every characteristic2 conductor partition generically; full-new vanishing requires at least two poles. Arbitrary closed special points remain open. C06/C06a lifts every finite cover map with smooth source and every smooth incidence geometrically. C07 proves the whole kernel sign if any known positive span leaves at most one potential Tate direction; no cycle lifting or arbitrary-point sign follows.

rows.question: Algebraically trivial Fermat radical
rows.finding_ids_or_current_gate: F15/F16 annihilate all resolved-image families with inherited Picard variety and all non-ample image surfaces in rational Chow. Remaining P18 gate: maps Hom(Jac(C), Pic0(Dtilde)/im Pic0(J))_Q→(pi1^C tensor p_N)CH2(C×J) for singular ample divisors D with q(Dtilde)>3. F06 still identifies the etale-motivic component as a rational vector space invisible to finite coefficients. No vanishing proved for this smaller family gate. F17 realizes this by one universal cycle on each excess Picard quotient. F18 kills the mixed CM elliptic subcomponent exactly, leaving CH2(N4) on E4 for j1728 elliptic excess factors. F19 further removes every image surface rationally dominated by a product of two curves, by exact Chow vanishing. F20 further kills surfaces whose grade-zero Albanese image class is distinguished; F21 supplies actual nonnormal ample examples with smooth normalization irregularity4.

For nonsupersingular degree7/char2, F12 gives unconditional I_num and I_13 on the square; F14 gives all-ell Tate,D,I on X itself. The requested prior-unknown-I(XxX) status is not certified.
